examples.title: Swapping matched elements for their text
examples.what_is_wrong: The loop wraps item.xpath() in a try/except marked 'pragma: no cover - defensive' that skips the item without a word, right after an isinstance early return.
examples.what_changed: Same loop, with the text step looked up in a dict and no defensive try/except.

examples.title: Listing saved media and preview filenames
examples.what_is_wrong: vault_filenames(name, dirname) is a parameterised copy of media_filenames, written 70 lines later. preview_filenames uses the general version, but nobody pointed media_filenames at it.
examples.what_changed: One asset_names(name, directory) helper, with media_names and preview_names as one-line wrappers. The other spectest run has the same shape.

examples.title: Classifying an entry for the digest
examples.what_is_wrong: The removal test, the addition test, the changed-field scan and the reappeared special case all sit in one function that returns a three-part tuple.
examples.what_changed: The removal test and the changed-field scan are their own functions, and reappeared becomes a label in the changed list instead of a third return value.

examples.title: One-assert CLI tests for text flags
examples.what_is_wrong: Each test is `proc = run_argv([...], PAGE)` and one assert, and only the argv and the expected string change. This test file is 2,571 lines. One pytest.mark.parametrize table of (argv, doc, expected) would replace the whole group.
